name: circuits
definition: 举办赛车比赛的固定场地设施，具有名称、所在地、国家及经纬度坐标等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛场次(races)」混淆：赛道是物理场地，同一赛道可举办多场不同年份的比赛。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table circuits; provenance: direct source circuits

name: constructors
definition: 以组织名义报名参赛并制造或提供赛车的实体，具有名称与国籍等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车手(drivers)」混淆：车队是组织实体，车手是自然人个体。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructors; provenance: direct source constructors

name: drivers
definition: 驾驶赛车参加比赛的自然人，具有姓名、出生日期、国籍与车号等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队(constructors)」混淆：车手是自然人，车队是组织。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table drivers; provenance: direct source drivers

name: races
definition: 在特定赛道于特定日期举行的一轮赛事活动，具有年份、轮次、日期等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「赛季(seasons)」混淆：赛季是年度周期，比赛场次是赛季内的单轮赛事。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table races; provenance: direct source races

name: seasons
definition: 以年度为单位的赛事周期，具有年份这一区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛场次(races)」混淆：赛季是年度周期，比赛场次是周期内的单场赛事。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table seasons; provenance: direct source seasons

name: status
definition: 描述比赛结果中车手或赛车所处情形的分类条目，具有状态名称这一区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛结果(results)」混淆：完赛状态是分类字典条目，比赛结果是具体赛事记录。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table status; provenance: direct source status

name: constructorResults
definition: 记录某车队在某场比赛中所获积分与状态的成绩条目，具有积分与状态等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队积分榜(constructorStandings)」混淆：比赛结果是单场成绩，积分榜是赛季累计排名。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructorResults; provenance: direct source constructorResults

name: constructorStandings
definition: 记录某车队在某场比赛后于赛季积分榜中的累计积分、排名与胜场数的排名条目，具有累计积分与名次等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队比赛结果(constructorResults)」混淆：积分榜是赛季累计排名，比赛结果是单场成绩。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table constructorStandings; provenance: direct source constructorStandings

name: driverStandings
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛后于赛季积分榜中的累计积分、排名与胜场数的排名条目，具有累计积分与名次等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛结果(results)」混淆：积分榜是赛季累计排名，比赛结果是单场成绩。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table driverStandings; provenance: direct source driverStandings

name: results
definition: 记录某车手驾驶某车队赛车在某场比赛中发车顺位、完赛名次、积分与最快圈速的成绩条目，具有名次与积分等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「车队比赛结果(constructorResults)」混淆：比赛结果以车手为单位，车队比赛结果以车队为单位。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table results; provenance: direct source results

name: lapTimes
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛中某一圈的用时与当圈排名的计时条目，具有圈号与用时等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「进站记录(pitStops)」混淆：单圈计时记录整圈用时，进站记录记录维修区停留时长。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table lapTimes; provenance: direct source lapTimes

name: pitStops
definition: 记录某车手在某场比赛中某次进站维修的圈号与停留时长的条目，具有进站次序与时长等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「单圈计时(lapTimes)」混淆：进站记录记录维修区停留，单圈计时记录整圈用时。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table pitStops; provenance: direct source pitStops

name: qualifying
definition: 记录某车手驾驶某车队赛车在某场比赛前进行的排位赛中三个阶段的成绩与名次的条目，具有阶段成绩与名次等区别特征。 Counterexample: 易与「比赛结果(results)」混淆：排位赛成绩决定发车顺位，比赛结果是正赛完赛成绩。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table qualifying; provenance: direct source qualifying

name: Driver
definition: A person who competes in Formula 1 races, identified by full name (forename + surname) or driverRef.

name: Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 team or manufacturer that builds and enters cars.

name: Race
definition: A single Formula 1 event held at a circuit on a specific date.

name: Circuit
definition: A physical racing venue with geographic coordinates (lat, lng).

name: RaceResult
definition: The outcome of a driver in a specific race, including finishing position, points, time, and fastest lap data.

name: DriverStanding
definition: Cumulative championship standings for a driver after a given race.

name: ConstructorStanding
definition: Cumulative championship standings for a constructor after a given race.

name: ConstructorResult
definition: Points and status earned by a constructor in a specific race.

name: Qualifying
definition: Qualifying session results for a driver in a race, split into Q1, Q2, Q3 segments.

name: PitStop
definition: A pit stop event during a race, with duration and lap information.

name: LapTime
definition: Time recorded for a specific lap by a driver in a race.

name: Status
definition: The reason or condition for a driver's race outcome (e.g., finished, accident, mechanical failure).

name: Season
definition: A Formula 1 season identified by year.

name: AccidentCount
definition: Total number of race results where the driver's status indicates an accident. Formula: COUNT(RaceResult) WHERE Status.statusId = 3. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId; Status = status.statusId WHERE statusId IN (1, 3)

name: FirstRaceYear
definition: The minimum year in which a driver participated in a race. Formula: MIN(Season.year) per Driver. Inputs: Driver = drivers.driverId; Season = seasons.year; RaceResult = results.resultId

name: AveragePitStopDuration
definition: Average duration of all pit stops for a driver. Formula: AVG(PitStop.duration) per Driver. Inputs: PitStop = pitStops.duration; Driver = drivers.driverId

name: FastestLapSpeed
definition: The maximum fastest lap speed recorded in a race or by a driver. Formula: MAX(RaceResult.fastestLapSpeed). Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: ChampionFinishTime
definition: The finish time of the driver who won the race (position = 1). Formula: MIN(RaceResult.time) WHERE RaceResult.position = 1. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: LastDriverFinishTime
definition: The finish time of the driver who finished last among those who finished. Formula: MAX(RaceResult.time) WHERE RaceResult.time IS NOT NULL. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: NonFirstPlacePercentage
definition: Percentage of races where a driver finished in position greater than 1. Formula: COUNT(RaceResult WHERE position > 1) / COUNT(RaceResult) * 100. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId; Driver = drivers.driverId

name: CircuitHeldCount
definition: Number of races held at circuits in a given country. Formula: COUNT(Race) WHERE Circuit.country = 'Austria'. Inputs: Race = races.raceId; Circuit = circuits.circuitId
aliases: how many times circuits were held

name: MaxConstructorPoints
definition: The maximum points scored by a constructor in a race or season. Formula: MAX(ConstructorResult.points). Inputs: ConstructorResult = constructorResults.constructorResultsId

name: DriverAge
definition: Age of a driver calculated from date of birth. Formula: DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, Driver.dob). Inputs: Driver = drivers.driverId

name: QualifyingEliminatedFirstPeriod
definition: Drivers eliminated in the first qualifying period (Q1), typically the 5 slowest. Formula: MAX(Qualifying.q1) per race. Inputs: Qualifying = qualifying.qualifyId

name: FinishedRaceCount
definition: Number of drivers who finished a race (time is not null). Formula: COUNT(RaceResult) WHERE RaceResult.time IS NOT NULL. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId

name: ParticipationCount
definition: Number of races a driver has participated in. Formula: COUNT(RaceResult.raceId) per Driver. Inputs: RaceResult = results.resultId; Driver = drivers.driverId

name: Nationality
definition: Analysis by driver or constructor nationality.

name: CircuitCountry
definition: Analysis of circuits by country and location.
